artworks.title: Study of a Right Arm and a Left Hand
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two hands and an arm. The drawing features a study of two hands; one hand is at the bottom of the image with spread fingers, while the other is at the upper left, extending outward, connected to an arm covered by fabric. The drawing uses pencil lines to depict the contours, shading for depth, and texture for the skin and fabric. The background is plain beige.

artworks.title: The Reaper (The Harvest Moon)
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing upright. He is facing forward with his head turned slightly upward. He has a youthful appearance with fair skin, short dark hair, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, brown jacket, white shirt, light-colored trousers, tall socks, and shoes. In one hand, he holds a sickle, and in the other hand, a round woven hat. Beside him is a small dog with a brown and white coat. The background consists of a rural landscape under a large, pale sky with a round shape resembling the sun or moon.

artworks.title: Blue Ridge Mountains
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, fields, distant mountains, and a sky with clouds. The painting has a watercolor style with soft brushstrokes, using muted earth tones such as green, brown, and blue. Trees and ground in the foreground lead the eye towards the mountainous horizon under a serene sky with patchy clouds.

artworks.title: Study of a Chair Leg
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate furniture leg. The drawing features a single, detailed leg of a piece of furniture with intricate carving. The leg has an elegant curve and textured surface, suggesting a classical decorative style. The use of pencil provides subtle shadowing and depth against a plain background.

artworks.title: A Family Group
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered together in a room. The drawing features several figures engaged in an activity involving a table. Some figures have well-defined outlines, while others are only suggested by faint strokes. The composition is centered around a table, with figures placed around it in various poses. Light and shadow are used to imply depth and the play of light across the scene. The drawing style is minimalistic yet expressive, with a sense of motion and interaction conveyed through deliberate strokes.

artworks.title: Landscape with Figures and a Carriage
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from a high angle. The horizon is high in the composition, with rolling terrain leading towards it. A small structure is visible in the distance on the left. In the foreground, a person in dark clothing faces away, observing a carriage pulled by two horses. A group of figures is gathered to the left. The artistic style features delicate brushstrokes, creating an ethereal effect. The color palette is muted, with pale blues, soft greens, and hints of beige, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Battle Scene
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows curved lines and rounded shapes forming an abstract composition. The shapes resemble a gathering of figures or a crowd in a busy public scene, conveying movement and a sense of bustle. The loose, sketchy lines suggest various scenarios such as gatherings in a public square or figures observing an event. The abstract nature of the drawing allows for multiple interpretations, with the loops and curves creating a complex narrative of forms.

artworks.title: An Ornate Ewer [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a large ornate urn or vase decorated with intricate carvings and handles, positioned centrally within the composition. The color palette consists of brown ink on a cream-colored paper, creating a monochrome appearance. The urn is placed vertically in the center of the image, with clear designs like floral motifs and intricate handles visible against a loosely sketched background. The urn's base sits on a surface indicated by a few strokes at the bottom, with other incomplete lines suggesting an unfinished setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Mother and Child [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a partial view of two figures. On the right, an individual is seated, displaying an upper body view, with one arm bent and possibly resting on their lap. The figure is sketched with simplified facial features, without detailed expression, and appears to have short to medium length hair. The clothing of this individual is not detailed, with only basic outlines suggesting garments draped around the body. The left side shows another figure with only a suggestion of the upper body and head, facing towards the seated individual. The background is plain and unadorned, giving no specific context or setting to the scene. There are no objects or jewelry visibly depicted in their hands or on their persons.

artworks.title: An Upraised Arm
artworks.medium: black and red chalks heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person's arm from the shoulder down to the hand. The arm is slightly bent, with the hand gripping a rod or pole. The arm is wearing a long sleeve with a cuff at the wrist. The drawing uses soft lines, shading, and a reddish tone to depict the clothing's texture. The background is plain beige, emphasizing the arm without any distractions. No facial features are visible.

artworks.title: A Tassel
artworks.medium: black, red, and yellow chalks heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a braided motif with decorative elements. The artwork features a loose braid intertwined with an ornamental tassel or knot design. The drawing is rendered in soft graphite, with touches of yellow and hints of pink for shading. The lines are fluid and sketchy, capturing the curves and movement of the braid, and the decorative segment adds a textural contrast with its pattern of dots and crosshatching. The composition focuses on the interplay between curves and textures.

artworks.title: House by the Beach at Tréboul
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a pencil drawing of a house surrounded by tall trees. The trees are drawn with varying line intensities, creating a textured effect. A pair of figures are seated close to the foreground. The drawing includes structures like telegraph poles and other buildings extending to the right. The sketch uses shades of gray and showcases a mixture of delicate and bold strokes to depict the house and foliage.

artworks.title: Study of a Seated Man's Legs
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping, heightened with white, on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the lower half of a seated person's body, from the waist down to just below the knees. The individual's right leg is crossed over the left. They are wearing dark, fitted pants which are slightly wrinkled at the knees and hips. The person is sitting on a cushioned surface with extra fabric visible underneath. The background is a shaded, textured surface with no visible objects or decorations. No jewelry or held objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Sandstorm in the Desert Overtaking a Caravan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This line drawing shows several figures with animals in a dynamic setting. The figures and animals are sketched with fluid, expressive lines, and the background is filled with swirling lines, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the scene. The style is loose and impressionistic.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the back in a seated position with their body turned slightly to the right. Most of the upper body, including the back, shoulder, and part of the arm, is visible. The person's head is turned to the right, displaying their profile. Their facial features are not entirely visible, but the side of their face can be seen. They have short, curly hair that is dark and slightly tousled. The person is nude and is sitting on a textured surface that appears to be a cloth or bedding. The background features a flat, textured pattern that doesn't display any specific details or objects. There are no visible jewelry or items being held by the person.

artworks.title: The "Farnese Flora" at Stourhead
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a classical female figure standing on a pedestal. The woman is shown in a relaxed pose with her weight shifted onto one leg. Her right arm is raised, holding onto a piece of drapery, while the left hand touches the fabric around her legs. She is dressed in a flowing garment with one shoulder exposed. The sculpture appears to be made of a smooth, marble-like material, with the drawing done in shades of white and gray pencil on a blue background. The woman's hair is styled in a classical fashion, with a band wrapped around her head. The illustration conveys a delicate and serene presence, utilizing light and shading techniques to create a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: A Lady Seated with a Parasol
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a woman sitting on a chair. She is leaning back, her left arm on the chair and her right hand holding a closed umbrella beside her. She has curly hair, and her face features a small nose and mouth. She wears a long gown that covers her feet. In the background are abstracted lines that suggest trees and foliage.

artworks.title: The Mall, Central Park
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This painting shows a scene from a slightly elevated perspective looking down towards a park filled with people. At the top, gray-green trees create a canopy. Below, people in light-colored dresses and suits walk, stand, and sit, some holding colorful parasols. They are painted in soft, loose brushstrokes, and have no facial features. The color scheme includes pale greens, browns, pinks, blues, and whites.

artworks.title: Docks, East Boston
artworks.medium: watercolor, graphite, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with ships and activity on the docks. The horizon line is in the upper third of the image, with a cityscape in the distance. Large sailing ships with tall masts and rigging dominate this section. The brushstrokes are loose and sketchy, conveying movement. The color palette includes blues, browns, and grays, with pops of red and yellow. Closest to us, there are horse-drawn carts and figures engaged in loading and unloading goods on the dock.

artworks.title: Harvest--The Plain of La Crau
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This drawing shows a landscape with fields extending towards the horizon. Hills, trees, and buildings are visible in the distance under a dotted sky. The fields are drawn in different sections, with areas of dots, short vertical marks, and small piles of overlapping lines. Among these sections are also haystacks, carts, and simply drawn people walking among the fields and rows of crops in the distance. The lines are varying shades of brown against off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Plaster Mill (La Moulin à plâtre)
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of architectural structures and natural forms from a perspective view. The sketch is on a horizontal paper with elements extending towards the right and receding to the left. Varied pencil lines are used to depict the buildings, terrain, and foliage. The sketch is monochromatic, created with pencil on beige paper. Subtle shading and line weight variations add depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: Study of Puget's "Milo of Crotona"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person lying on their back. The person is drawn horizontally across the canvas, their body in a relaxed pose with arms by their side. The face has minimal detail, with a suggestion of the nose and closed eyes, and long hair flowing behind the head. The person appears unclothed with emphasis on muscular details depicted with soft, rounded lines. The background is blank, drawing focus on the figure.

artworks.title: The Artist's Son Leaning on his Elbow
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The sketch shows a partial view of a person's upper body. The individual is leaning forward, possibly resting their head on their right arm, which is bent. The facial features are subtly drawn with closed eyes and calm expression. The person has short, slightly tousled hair. The drawing focuses only on the upper body with no clothing shown, and there are no visible items of jewelry or objects. The background is plain and unembellished, like a sketchbook or plain piece of paper.

artworks.title: Landscape Near Aix-en-Provence
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: At least four buildings are lightly sketched in black graphite across two long pages of an open notebook. The largest of the four buildings is to the right, and it nearly spans the height of the page. It has three levels and a chimney. Three buildings stretching to the left may be conjoined to each other and possibly to the first structure. These have one or two stories and are sketched with less detail. Trees and shrubs peek over and around these structures. The leftmost quarter of the spread is harder to make out. A horizontal line near the top edge of that sheet could be a high horizon with trees and perhaps a church steeple silhouetted against the sky. Under that, some horizontal and vertical lines at first suggest another structure of some kind, but details as well as some darker shapes there are difficult to interpret. The paper is yellowed with age.
